rundown: Bison beat Dolphins 57-41 at Ted Grant Court in Syracuse, NY. Bison led 25-21 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Bison won it 22-9.
Leading the way — Bison: Isabella Casey 14 pts; Elana Weisman 6 ast; Reese Zemitis 6 reb. Dolphins: Gianna Nichols 11 pts; Eli Clark 4 ast, 7 reb.
Where Bison won it: they shot 38% to 33%, shot 45% from three to 20% and had 15 assists to 10.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 10:55 AM ET. It had Bison 78% and Dolphins 22%, projecting Bison 68.6 – Dolphins 58.9 (127.5 total, Bison by 9.8).

Final: Bison 57 – Dolphins 41. Right winner: it had Bison at 78%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bison came in with a 6% below average attack and a 6% leakier than average defense (1-5, 62.3 scored and 67.3 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 163 and 162 games of evidence. Projected to score 68.6, they scored 57 (−11.6 points, 17% under); projected to allow 58.9, they allowed 41 (−17.9 points, 30% under).

Dolphins came in with a 17% below average attack and a 14% leakier than average defense (1-5, 48.5 scored and 76 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 166 and 169 games of evidence. Projected to score 58.9, they scored 41 (−17.9 points, 30% under); projected to allow 68.6, they allowed 57 (−11.6 points, 17% under).

The bigger miss was Dolphins' scoring (-17.9 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 98 against 127.5 projected (-29.5), about the 2nd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Bison by 16 against Bison by 9.8 projected, about the 32nd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.747 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -4.9 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 990 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.971 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Bison attack ×0.978, defense ×0.974 (6 games); Dolphins attack ×0.960, defense ×0.998 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
